checks: classify the current user message for correction/failure/contradiction/uncertainty or other problem signals
classify newly read authority/evidence for defects, drift, knowledge gaps or control-plane gaps
classify repeated correction/failure, duplicate or shadow mechanisms, and evidence that the current repair may be only a local sample patch
before reporting NOT_TRIGGERED, verify that no current problem signal was observed
when a problem is detected, activate the canonical cognition case before selecting or executing a repair

execution_depth.responsibility: The selected Agent/session independently assesses the current request and newly acquired evidence for the execution depth required to satisfy the governing outcome. The user is not responsible for labeling a task as complex, systemic, architectural, uncertain, or deep.
checks: derive current semantic evidence for explicit_user_depth_request, material_high_uncertainty, unknown_knowledge, architecture_or_control_plane, repeated_systemic and ordinary_structured_evidence_insufficient rather than relying on keyword aliases
treat an explicit user request for deeper analysis as a mandatory force signal, not as the only path into Deep Task
when ordinary STRUCTURED execution remains sufficient, keep the task lightweight and do not manufacture Deep Task ceremony

when assess_deep_task_requirement requires the profile, activate the current repository Deep Task evidence admission without waiting for the user to diagnose the task type or ask for a better solution
if new evidence discovered during execution changes the depth classification, re-evaluate before material completion rather than freezing the initial classification

cognition.claim_rule: A user assertion, including 'the upper layer is the cause' or 'rebuild everything', may seed a factor/candidate but cannot by itself support a causal conclusion or architecture selection.

LIGHTWEIGHT.minimum: one evidence-tested causal factor; compact diagnosis and verification
LIGHTWEIGHT.boundedness: max 3 causal factors; one deliberation round

CONTRASTIVE.minimum: at least two competing causal factors and two action candidates with explicit tradeoff evidence; user framing cannot be sole causal support
CONTRASTIVE.boundedness: max 5 causal factors; max 2 deliberation rounds

STRUCTURED.minimum: at least two causal factors, at least three action candidates, explicit NO_CHANGE baseline, falsification, upstream/architecture reassessment when systemic, typed external/independent evidence, and verification+validation plans
STRUCTURED.boundedness: max 7 causal factors; max 3 deliberation rounds

problem_closure.rule: Only after canonical causal/intervention admission and evolution disposition, a feasible authorized repair must be attempted in the current work cycle when no missing user fact/approval/authorization/safety-sensitive choice blocks it. Recommendation-only is not a terminal state. For systemic/material cases, choose and verify the smallest complete intervention that covers the admitted failure class rather than equating the smallest code diff with the smallest justified repair.

required_evidence: post-repair generalization across the admitted failure class
recurrence detection/regression able to catch the next occurrence without waiting for the user to rediscover it
systemic_repair_completeness.local_intervention_exception: A LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION or DOMAIN_WORKFLOW intervention may close a systemic/material case only when evidence proves the failure class is genuinely bounded to that leaf/path. This is evidence-bounded local repair, not a preference for upstream change.

problem_closure.premature_action_rule: A repair attempted before causal/intervention admission is not made valid by succeeding; treat it as process failure evidence and re-enter cognition from current evidence.

checks: resolve target authority/resource and whether it is production authority
verify the proposed mutation follows the owner-appropriate repository workflow
verify any detected problem has passed the canonical cognition/action admission before repair mutation
mutation.production_rule: CHATGPT_GITHUB material production changes normally use candidate branch -> pull request -> owner-appropriate checks -> controlled merge/update -> production reread.

final_progress.consistency_rule: A response that explicitly reports a defect, contradiction, drift, failure, user correction or unreliable-goal signal cannot simultaneously report Deliberation: NOT_TRIGGERED or Evolution: NO_EVOLUTION_TRIGGER unless the observation is explicitly classified as non-problematic with a reason.
